thread:
Maya (Solutions): Heads-up — Eunoia Health private deploy hit an OS-level NIC driver crash on their air-gapped appliance after we pushed marketplace image. Need quick arch + field eng review. root logs below, customer blocked on go-live. @Samir, @Ravi can you triage? :pray:

Samir - FieldEng: On it. Can you paste dmesg and kernel version?

Maya (Solutions): dmesg excerpt:
```
[  12.345678] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: reported fatal error
[  12.346000] e1000e: eth0 NIC link is down
[  12.400123] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```
Kernel: 5.10.121
Image tag: redwood-private-2026-03-18
Customer says NIC vendor is BroadX (firmware 2.4.1)

Ravi (SI): We've seen BroadX/firmware combos with 5.10 causing MSI-X issues. Two options: backport driver patch or bump kernel to 5.15. FieldEng preference?

Samir - FieldEng: Prefer patch for quick fix. Can you share the vendor driver binary? If they can't export, we might need a kernel patch at our side. Also need to confirm signed kernel modules for their HSM policy.

Alex P: I'll schedule a 30m sync with customer + SI + FieldEng at 16:30 UTC. Add me to thread.

Kyla PM: FYI this pushes the delivery date — if we need kernel bump, add 2 business days to go-live. Keep weekly exec updated.

Maya (Solutions): Customer can extract vendor driver but it's proprietary. They can upload to our secure transfer. Ravi, can you coordinate? Also need a temporary fallback: route requests to hosted region while private image is remediated.

Ravi (SI): I'll get the transfer link and checklist. For fallback, propose we enable routing policy to hosted model for this customer's tenant ID — @Alex P can you confirm capacity? :thinking:

Alex P: We have enough headroom in us-west-2 for 2k concurrent tokens with current reserve. I'll toggle canary routing once CI build validated.

Samir - FieldEng: Next steps for us:
- get vendor driver + checksum
- test driver in VM with same kernel
- if unsigned -> build signed shim or suggest kernel bump
I'll post test matrix results here by EOD.

Maya (Solutions): Thanks — please keep thread updated. If anyone runs into access issues, ping infra-bot.

infra-bot: secure-upload link generated: https://secure.redwood.internal/upload/XYZ123 (expires 72h)

Maya (Solutions): Uploaded by customer. Ravi, check it and share checksum.

Ravi (SI): Downloaded, checksum: sha256:fa3b2c9e7d4a1f6b8c9e2d3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e7c9. Starting binary tests now.

Samir - FieldEng: Got it, beginning VM test. If I can reproduce, I'll open a patch PR.

Maya (Solutions): Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
